svg.title: Build 017: The Risk Lives Between the Boxes — official-source context cover
svg.desc: Official NIST AI RMF GOVERN 2 excerpt requiring clear roles and communication lines, trained personnel and partners, and executive responsibility for AI-risk decisions. Bounded official-source excerpt; not evidence of prototype performance or institutional endorsement.
